auths.name: none
auths.explain: No credential; the server is open or trusts the connection.

auths.name: bearer
auths.explain: Sends `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`; the secret is the token.

auths.name: basic
auths.explain: Sends HTTP basic auth; the secret is `user:password`.

auths.name: header
auths.explain: Sends the secret in a header of your choice (auth header name, e.g. X-Api-Key).

auths.name: query
auths.explain: Appends the secret as a query parameter of your choice (auth header name is the parameter).

auths.name: env
auths.explain: Passes the secret to the stdio command as an environment variable (auth header name is the variable).
